title: Many small bots beat one assistant.
text: Give each job its own bot (news briefings, brand mentions, prospecting), then put several in one chat to work as a team.

title: Tell the agent what done looks like.
text: Evaluation matters more than the model: an agent with a clear definition of done can keep looping until it gets there.

title: Long autonomous runs need supervision built in.
text: A coordinating agent that checks every pull request, and a heartbeat that notices when an agent has stopped, kept five agents productive for 30 hours.

title: Automate what already works.
text: That 30-hour run rested on seven weeks of building first. Get the product working, then automate the workflow you know.

title: Removing names doesn't protect anyone.
text: A few details, like a family of five that arrived in March, are enough to identify someone among thousands, and every session with a model adds another.

title: Collect fields, not stories.
text: Keep sensitive detail out of prompts and the model's files. If a device is seized, the session logs show exactly who was spoken to.
